title: Odyssey
desc_lfm_album: Odyssey is Home's second album, released on July 1, 2014. It contains twelve tracks, ranging from three to five minutes in length, with the exception of the titular track "Odyssey", which is over six minutes. The album was released in 2016 as a physical black vinyl disc before selling out. It featured all the original songs, alternative artwork, and 5 previously unreleased demos as bonus tracks to conclude the album. It was later re-released as a translucent orange vinyl, which also sold out. The five bonus tracks are entitled "Flatline", "Heading Up", "Oracle", "Rains", "Soak" and "Somewhere in Silence". .
desc_lfm_artist:

desc_lfm_artist:
Franck Hueso, better known by his stage name Carpenter Brut, is a synthwave/electronic music artist from Poitiers, Nouvelle-Aquitaine, France. Little personal information is known about him aside from his origin. His anonymity is a deliberate artistic choice in order to place more importance on the music itself rather than the identity of the musician behind it.

He first released the initial three EPs, which were collected together and released together under the title Trilogy in 2015.
